home.heroLine: A South African Consultancy, built around the placement.
home.aboutHeading: Matched to the work, not just the job title.
home.aboutBody: Finding the right candidate takes more than matching a CV to a job description. We take the time to understand the role, the business and the people behind it, connecting employers with professionals who bring the right experience, skills and fit.
home.industriesIntro: Every industry has its own demands. We match roles to the skills and experience each site, plant, or team actually needs.
home.placementsBody: We look beyond the job title to understand the role, the working environment and what makes someone the right fit. Employers find people suited to their business, while candidates find opportunities that align with their experience and ambitions. Across six industry sectors, we bring both sides together to build lasting working relationships.
